notes: Baseline feel/captures were run against an isolated static export restoring the exact four changed runtime files from 448aff64; no source branch/worktree was reset. Native 32-unit background tiles were used in both captures; no new playable map was added.

The baseline reproduced upward idle aiming with retained world look (0,0). Its proximity trace did not change raw look coordinates; the broader reported visual snap was not conclusively reproduced. New tests inspect both policy/native state and shared weapon pose across contact, sleep and transitions.

One early physical regression completed gameplay checks but caught a pre-existing native menu preview URL for assets/grenade_launcher.png after texture relocation. The offline exporter now aliases the existing local gun texture, without changing weapon definitions. Optional rocket_loop.wav remains missing upstream.

Native decals initially self-removed because the lab indexed them before their first Think. Creation now follows native SendEffect ordering, and the physical test explicitly checks surviving attached marks after native Think/hash update.

Final feel/hostility checks were rerun after strengthening positive decal and actual-projectile recovery assertions, advancing native gun timers, and matching passive-spawn capture framing. Runtime code was unchanged during that test-only follow-up.

Frozen fixtures advance actual characters, held guns where relevant, projectiles and effect lifecycles. Test randomness is controlled only for native shot spread; no collision, damage or ragdoll solver is mocked.
Old milestone evidence is unchanged. Existing suites wrote outputs to /tmp. Player health is temporarily raised in active-AI observation fixtures and restored to native 250 on encounter reset.
Linux Chromium 156 / SwiftShader; no macOS hardware performance or subjective realism/feel claim. No new external dependencies, artwork or music.
